snippet.title: Carpark Hero - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Carpark Hero here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3995930/Carpark_Hero/

Carpark Hero is a 2-8 player online pvp game with friends, where you race against your friends to secure a limited number of parking spots each round! Wacky physics, big hits and lots of laughs.

Gameplay Loop:
1. Race your friends each round across handcrafted maps to park your car.
2. Every round there is always 1 less parking spot available than there are players.
3. Whoever doesn't get one is eliminated.
4. Repeat.
5. The game finishes in an intense 1 v 1 battle, which will leave just 1 car standing!

Its just like musical chairs but with parking spaces.
